column1: # When each path last changed, as DAYS<TAB>HH:MM<TAB>PATH: that many days
# before the seed's clock, at that time of day (UTC). seed.sh reads this file,
# and checks can too (for example "which downloads are older than 60 days").
# Paths are relative to /home/learner. Folders not listed take the time of
# their newest entry. Anything else takes the default below.
